name: Noshiro Kunoe
source:
A girl with a kind and somewhat sloppy personality who attends ordinary department, she always cuts classes and avoids involving herself with people for some reason. She is in a close relationship with Kana who always takes care of her.

[spoiler]The reason for her strange behavior is because she was abducted by bad people during her childhood and got bad reputation since then which makes her afraid of getting attention.[/spoiler]
